---
title: "Mallard Duck Movement"
---

Mallards tracked with GPS move widely around Lake Constance, a large lake on the borders of Germany, Switzerland, and Austria. The [Map](map.qmd) follows their fixes and travel paths across central Europe, showing how individuals are distributed over the tracking region.

The [Seasons](seasons.qmd) page explores when movement occurs. Month-by-month plots reveal changes in mallard travel speeds, while the data are grouped into seasons to make recurring patterns easier to compare.

The data come from mallard tracking observations in the `PPBDS/misc.tutorials` repository. Lake Constance (also called Bodensee) provides a natural regional reference point for understanding the locations and movement patterns in the dataset.
